body.p: Any changes to the text to correct typographical errors are listed at the end of the book. Minor changes to formatting have been made without comment.

Several symbols appear in the left margin of certain catalogue entries: the equals sign (=), en-dash (–) and a circular "bullet" (●). No explanation is given in the book for the significance of these symbols which are reproduced as in the original.

div.head: ARTICLE I.
div.p: Section 1. This Society is constituted to encourage and promote:
(1). The study of postage, telegraph and fiscal stamps, stamped envelopes, newspaper and other bands, and postal cards, their history, engraving, printing and other details.
(2). The detection and prevention of forgeries and frauds.

(3). The preparation and publication of papers and books bearing upon these subjects, and the undertaking of all such matters as may incidentally promote the above objects and contribute to the increase of the science and practice of Philately.
